result.summary: This residential intersection features sidewalks on both sides but lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure like marked crosswalks or curb ramps. Parked vehicles on both sides of the narrow one-way street significantly obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians at the crossing point.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection to alert drivers to pedestrian activity.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars right up to the corner block the view of pedestrians for oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street near the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps makes the crossing inaccessible for wheelchair users or those with strollers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Build out the sidewalk at the corners to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the intersection to ensure clear sightlines.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection equipped with a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and a traffic signal. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the environment lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and features parked cars that may obstruct sight lines.

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars on the right side of the street near the crosswalk can block the line of sight between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway near the crosswalk

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signal
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal head is visible to guide people crossing the street at this signalized intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility by moving pedestrians past parked cars.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signals that show the remaining time to cross, improving safety and predictability for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines between all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection in a mixed-use urban area with marked zebra crosswalks and continuous sidewalks. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the wide crossing distance and parked vehicles near the corners create potential visibility and exposure risks.

hazards.name: Parked vehicle sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners may block the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the street leading into the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks and paved sidewalks on both sides of a two-lane street. While traffic signals are present, there are no visible pedestrian-specific signals, and parked vehicles near the crossing may obstruct sightlines.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parking
hazards.description: Parked cars on the left side of the street are positioned very close to the crosswalk, potentially blocking the view between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway, immediately preceding the crosswalk

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, which can lead to confusion about when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear guidance for crossing.
